review: assistant visual review; draft for user review
reviewChecks: One continuous cavern garden rather than separate panels.
One white-painted open gazebo in the northern rosebed, with tea table visible inside.
Continuous path skirts the rosebed and winds through central flowerbeds into the southern topiary.
Northern overgrown opening, central plain western hedge gap and southern western rose arbor remain distinct.
Dragon, unicorn, serpent, misshapen dog and several human figures are leafy topiary rather than live actors.
Visible rock roof with glowing moss, no open sky or water feature, no permanently placed living unicorn.
limitations: Illustrated spatial layout and scale are authoring proposals, not measured navigable geometry.
Portable objects and changing actor/puzzle states must remain independently observed in the game.
